observation_timing.note: Measurements were collected earlier in this session. Exact per-command UTC observation timestamps were not captured; recorded_at_utc is the manifest creation time, not a fabricated measurement time.

scope.note: The root agent is separately preparing a repository CPU .venv. This report describes the existing environments observed before that preparation; it is not the eventual training-environment manifest.

wsl.note: Only wsl --list --verbose was run. No Linux-side Python or CUDA environment was inspected.

torch_metadata.interpretation: CUDA and sm_120 metadata are available. Real forward/backward operation and P1 readiness remain unverified.

commands.path_redaction_note: Commands preserve the executed invocations and code; absolute user-profile prefixes are replaced by <conda_root> or <windows_user_apps>. No username or hostname is retained.
hardware_queries: $osInfo = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $memInfo = Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem; $driveInfo = Get-PSDrive C; [pscustomobject]@{OS=$osInfo.Caption;Version=$osInfo.Version;Build=$osInfo.BuildNumber;RAMBytes=$memInfo.TotalPhysicalMemory;FreeRAMKiB=$osInfo.FreePhysicalMemory;DiskCUsedBytes=$driveInfo.Used;DiskCFreeBytes=$driveInfo.Free} | ConvertTo-Json
commands.wsl_query: $wslCheck = Start-Process -FilePath wsl.exe -ArgumentList '--list','--verbose' -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput "$env:TEMP/namethatllm-wsl-out.txt" -RedirectStandardError "$env:TEMP/namethatllm-wsl-err.txt"; if (-not $wslCheck.WaitForExit(10000)) { Stop-Process -Id $wslCheck.Id; Write-Output 'WSL list timed out after 10 seconds' }; Get-Content "$env:TEMP/namethatllm-wsl-out.txt"; Get-Content "$env:TEMP/namethatllm-wsl-err.txt"
